evidence.notes: Public Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter constructor shape stores local DTO fields.
Public Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter constructor shape stores local DTO fields.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeProcessPluginConstructorEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter inputShort = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter('recordId', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING, true); System.assertEquals('recordId', inputShort.name); System.assertEquals(Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING, inputShort.parameterType); System.assertEquals(true, inputShort.required); Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter inputLong = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.InputParameter('amount', 'Amount', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.DECIMAL, false); System.assertEquals('amount', inputLong.name); System.assertEquals('Amount', inputLong.description); System.assertEquals(Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.DECIMAL, inputLong.parameterType); System.assertEquals(false, inputLong.required); Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter outputShort = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter('message', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING); System.assertEquals('message', outputShort.name); System.assertEquals(Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.STRING, outputShort.parameterType); Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter outputLong = new Process.PluginDescribeResult.OutputParameter('done', 'Done', Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.BOOLEAN); System.assertEquals('done', outputLong.name); System.assertEquals('Done', outputLong.description); System.assertEquals(Process.PluginDescribeResult.ParameterType.BOOLEAN, outputLong.parameterType); } }
